Changes:
- Added `Presence.UpdateRemoteCluster(ctx, rc)` and local backend persistence under `remoteClusters/<name>` with the resource expiry.

- Wired the new interface method through the role checked auth wrapper and HTTP client/server.
- Added auth lifecycle coverage for creation, update, partial deletion, final deletion, list results, and stored values; added local expiry coverage and shared client update coverage.

- `git diff --check`: passed (final run).
- Initial focused test compile failed because `AuthWithRoles` and `Client` did not implement the expanded `Presence` interface; both were implemented and final tests passed.

+++ b/lib/auth/remotecluster_status_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+package auth
+
+import (
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/services"
+	. "gopkg.in/check.v1"
+)
+
+func (s *AuthSuite) TestRemoteClusterHeartbeatSurvivesTunnelDeletion(c *C) {
+	const clusterName = "remote.example.com"
+	rc, err := services.NewRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.CreateRemoteCluster(rc), IsNil)
+
+	checkStatus := func(status string, heartbeat time.Time) {
+		got, err := s.a.GetRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+		c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+		c.Assert(got.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(got.GetLastHeartbeat(), DeepEquals, heartbeat)
+		clusters, err := s.a.GetRemoteClusters()
+		c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+		c.Assert(clusters, HasLen, 1)
+		c.Assert(clusters[0].GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(clusters[0].GetLastHeartbeat(), DeepEquals, heartbeat)
+		stored, err := s.a.Presence.GetRemoteCluster(clusterName)
+		c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+		c.Assert(stored.GetConnectionStatus(), Equals, status)
+		c.Assert(stored.GetLastHeartbeat(), DeepEquals, heartbeat)
+	}
+
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline, time.Time{})
+	base := time.Now().UTC().Add(-time.Second)
+	first, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("first", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: clusterName, ProxyName: "proxy1", LastHeartbeat: base,
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	second, err := services.NewTunnelConnection("second", services.TunnelConnectionSpecV2{
+		ClusterName: clusterName, ProxyName: "proxy2", LastHeartbeat: base.Add(time.Second),
+	})
+	c.Assert(err, IsNil)
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(first), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, base)
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(second), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, base.Add(time.Second))
+	second.SetLastHeartbeat(base.Add(2 * time.Second))
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.UpsertTunnelConnection(second), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, base.Add(2*time.Second))
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(clusterName, second.GetName()), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOnline, base.Add(2*time.Second))
+	c.Assert(s.a.Presence.DeleteTunnelConnection(clusterName, first.GetName()), IsNil)
+	checkStatus(teleport.RemoteClusterStatusOffline, base.Add(2*time.Second))
+}
